note_on_0_9: Counts from scripts/claim-counts.py at public dbb8db6 (2026-10-24). Spec document draft 0.9. There is one language: the specification at one commit. The standard library is batteries-included and hash-pinned, and it is built into the checker (rce lib). Source is the openIE-dev/rce monorepo. The interactive notebook (spec-src/rce/spec.json) was regenerated from the same commit, including Appendix F. Theorems T1 to T62 are stated. Of the Appendix F obligations T42 to T56, T48, T51 and T53 are proved of models and the other twelve are unproved. T57 is proved for the one-step morphism equation and its uniqueness clause is unproved. T58 is proved. T59 is proved over an explicit finite alphabet and unproved over all of E. T60 is stated and unproved. T61 is tested for renaming only and otherwise unproved. T62 is proved on a model. The Lean kernel audit was not rerun at this commit.
lean_audit_definition: The audit (scripts/lean-audit.sh, audit/Audit.lean) counts every theorem constant in the kernel environment, including constants the elaborator generates, so it is larger than the number of theorem and lemma declarations written in source. It was not rerun at dbb8db6. The last audit recorded here is 4,877 theorem constants at e416fd0. The paper's 2,192 was the audit count at engine commit 1eb5f02 over 31 modules.
theorems_stated_unproved_in_0_9: Appendix F: T42 to T56 except T48, T51 and T53 (those three are proved of models). Also unproved, from the theorem index at this commit: T57's uniqueness clause, T59 over all of E, T60, and T61 beyond the renaming tests. T58 is proved. T62 is proved on a model.
